chunks: He said: 'In the rooster are five characteristics from the characteristics of the Prophets — generosity, bravery, contentment, knowledge of the times of prayers, and frequency of mating and protective jealousy.'

key_terms.السَّخَاء: Generosity, magnanimity — one of the most praised virtues in Islamic ethics
key_terms.الْغَيْرَة: Protective jealousy, self-esteem, honor — the sentiment that motivates a person to guard what is sacred and defend their household
key_terms.خِصَال: Characteristics, noble traits — plural of خَصْلَة, a positive quality or virtue

ai.seo_question: What five prophetic traits does Imam al-Kadhim attribute to the rooster?
ai.summary: Imam Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) describes five noble prophetic traits found in the rooster: generosity, bravery, contentment, awareness of prayer times, and zeal in procreation and protecting one's family. This hadith reflects the classical Islamic tradition of drawing moral lessons from observations of the natural world. The Imam's audience would have understood this as an exhortation to cultivate these prophetic virtues by contemplating the signs of God in creation.
